simpledinos.egg.brooded: This egg is already brooded. It hatches soon.
simpledinos.egg.occupied: Somebody is already sitting on this egg.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.hatch:
A brooded egg hatches only when its owner (the
longest sitter) is online, in the same dimension and
within 16 blocks. Off: a player nearby gets the
hatchling if the owner is offline. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.trice:
A Triceratops charge against the trunk of a
natural tree shakes fruit, saplings and sticks
loose; the tree stays. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.shake:
Share of the natural leaves whose hand drops
fall per shake (at most 40 rolls). 0 to 1.
Default: 0.5.

Chance of an extra apple from oak and dark oak
per shake. 0 to 1. Default: 0.35.

Seconds a shaken tree rests; meanwhile it only
knocks dully. 60 to 3600. Default: 600.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.ramCo:
Seconds between two Triceratops charges (shown
in the jump bar). 1 to 30. Default: 3.
simpledinos.guide.page.1.title: Simple Dinosaurs
simpledinos.guide.page.1: Brush a fossil block free for a dinosaur egg, sit on the egg to brood it, and raise a hatchling into a rideable T. rex or Triceratops.
simpledinos.guide.page.2.title: Fossil block
simpledinos.guide.page.2: A very rare find in the underground of deserts, badlands and swamps. Mined with Silk Touch it stays a block; without it, it breaks into up to two bones and the find is lost. Brush it with the Vanilla brush:
simpledinos.guide.page.3.title: Fossil block
simpledinos.guide.page.3: after about a minute of brushing, a dinosaur egg falls out.
simpledinos.guide.page.4.title: Dinosaur eggs
simpledinos.guide.page.4: One egg per dinosaur: T. rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Utahraptor and Parasaurolophus. Place the egg, then sit on it with an empty hand (right click):
simpledinos.guide.page.5.title: Dinosaur eggs
simpledinos.guide.page.5: after 5 minutes of sitting it is brooded, after 10 more minutes it hatches into a hatchling that belongs to the player who sat longest.
simpledinos.guide.page.6.title: T. rex
simpledinos.guide.page.6: The combat mount: three-quarter life size, a core hitbox of 3.6 x 3.5 blocks (head and tail reach beyond it). It hatches as a tame hatchling at a quarter of its size and grows to full size in 40 minutes (setting growMinutes); meat speeds growth up.
simpledinos.guide.page.7.title: T. rex
simpledinos.guide.page.7: Only adults carry a rider, with a large saddle.
simpledinos.guide.page.8.title: Triceratops
simpledinos.guide.page.8: The tree shaker: a heavy quadruped mount that hatches tame like the T. rex. Hold the jump key to charge, release it to run forward; when its horns hit the trunk of a natural tree, apples, saplings and sticks fall and the tree stays.
simpledinos.guide.page.9.title: Triceratops
simpledinos.guide.page.10.title: Large saddle and dinosaur armor
simpledinos.guide.page.10: The large saddle (a saddle, 4 leather and 4 iron ingots) fits only dinosaurs; one rider.
simpledinos.guide.page.11.title: Large saddle and dinosaur armor
simpledinos.guide.page.11: Each dinosaur has its own armor in leather, iron and diamond with the protection values of the Vanilla horse armor (3, 5, 11): T.
simpledinos.guide.page.12.title: Large saddle and dinosaur armor
simpledinos.guide.page.12: rex armor from 8 of the material around a bone block, Triceratops armor around a Triceratops eggshell.
simpledinos.guide.page.13.title: Commands
simpledinos.guide.page.13: /simpledinos config shows and changes every option of config/simpledinos-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpledinos.guide.page.14.title: Commands
simpledinos.guide.page.14: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
simpledinos.guide.page.15.title: Settings
simpledinos.guide.page.15: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
